territories.name: Palau
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Palau levies a goods and services tax of its own under Chapter 12 of Title 40 of the Palau National Code, as replaced by RPPL 11-11: the Palau Goods and Services Tax (PGST) is charged at 10 per cent from 1 January 2023, zero-rated supplies bear 0 per cent, financial services are exempt, and a registered person files a monthly return on form Tax 500 with the Bureau of Revenue and Taxation.
